record.one_liner: Work management platform (boards, items, columns) with a GraphQL API and hosted MCP servers.
record.auth_notes: Personal V2 API tokens for direct use; OAuth 2.0 (legacy flow, with a newer OAuth 2.1 flow also documented) for apps acting on behalf of users.
record.access_notes: A free developer account gives an API token to start testing, per the authentication and basics pages.
record.api_notes: GraphQL API covers boards, items, column values, users, workspaces and more; Workforms not supported.
record.blocker_notes: Did not verify whether production OAuth apps need a marketplace or app review; the fetched docs did not state it.

evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
OAuth 2.0 is a protocol that lets your app request authorization to read or modify data in a user's monday account.
For building and testing apps or API integrations without touching production data, use a free developer account.
The monday GraphQL API is part of the monday apps framework.
monday.com provides two MCP servers covering different parts of the developer lifecycle
If you don't have a monday.com account yet, create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.
